nodes.name: Forward Raw Webhook to AxonFlow API
nodes.notes:
IMPORTANT: Forwards the original raw body bytes and the original Cal.com signature header.
Do NOT parse or re-serialize the body before sending — the HMAC is verified
against the exact bytes received from Cal.com. The application API performs
the authoritative signature verification.

ERROR HANDLING:
- HTTP 2xx: normal completion — no further action.
- HTTP 4xx: client error (bad signature, duplicate, unsupported event).
  These are NOT retried (retrying a 400/401 will always fail again).
  A log entry is written via the '4xx Client Error Log' node.
- HTTP 5xx: server error — controlled retry (up to 2 retries, 5s apart).
  Persistent failure routes to Slack alert.
- continueOnFail=true so the error branch executes instead of halting the workflow.

nodes.name: 4xx Client Error Log
nodes.notes:
Do NOT retry 4xx responses. They indicate a permanent client-side error:
- 400 Bad Request (malformed payload, unsupported event type)
- 401 Unauthorized (invalid or missing HMAC signature)
- 413 Payload Too Large
Retrying these will always produce the same failure. Log and complete cleanly.

nodes.name: Slack Error Alert
nodes.notes:
Fires only on persistent 5xx failures after retry exhaustion.
SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL must be configured as an n8n environment variable.
No Slack credentials or webhook URLs are hardcoded in this workflow.

main.node: Forward Raw Webhook to AxonFlow API

securityPolicy.n8nRole: raw body relay only — no HMAC implementation in n8n

errorHandling.4xx: log and drop — no retry (client errors are permanent)
errorHandling.5xx: retry up to 2 times (5s apart) then Slack alert
